导演部办公室内，刘济民跟谢铁骊敲定好后，就由刘济民打电话联系朱霖。
朱霖家没有电话，刘济民只能把电话打到胡同口的公用电话上。等了好久，才接通了电话。
“喂，您找谁？”电话那头传来了一声懒洋洋的声音，这是专门负责管理电话的热心大妈。
刘济民不知道朱霖家的具体地址，于是提了一嘴朱教授，热心大妈立即知道了是谁家。
“我这就喊朱家大闺女过来接电话？”大妈笑着说道。
“不用您这么折腾，您帮我带个话就行。”
“成，您说...哎呦，朱教授，您这是买菜回来了？正好，您家里的电话，找你闺女的。”
朱霖的父亲听到刘济民的声音，顿时心中升起了一丝不妙的感觉。
“你是谁？跟我们家霖霖很熟？”
刘济民咳嗽了一声，正色道：“您就是朱霖同志的父亲吧？我是朱霖同志的同学，现在在燕影厂改剧本。导演觉得朱霖同志非常适合里面的一个女性角色，所以想询问一下朱霖同志的意见。”
“编剧？你们不会是骗子吧？”朱父沉吟道，显然还有点不相信。
“朱叔叔，您让朱霖同志接电话，是真是假，自有分辨。”
朱父心中已经信了七七八八，不过为了保证百分百没问题，特意回家将朱霖喊了过来。
朱霖听到是刘济民的声音，立即捂着话筒低声说道：“济民同志，你怎么把电话打到我家里来了？”
“咳！”刘济民忍不住咳嗽了一声，这话说的，好像两人有什么见不得人的事情似的。
朱父只是告诉有人找，但也没说具体事情。不过看到朱霖的语气，就知道事情没错儿。
嘶！不过自家闺女这抱着电话心虚的样子，不正常啊！
刘济民将事情告诉了朱霖，她直接惊呼道：“真的？”
“真的！你这两天在家准备准备，等到8月19号来一趟燕影厂试镜。”

In the director's office, after Liu Jimin and Xie Tieli finalized the decision, Liu Jimin called Zhu Lin.
Zhu Lin's house didn't have a phone, so Liu Jimin could only call the public phone at the entrance of the alley. After waiting for a long time, I got through the phone.
"Hey, who are you looking for?" A lazy voice came from the other end of the phone. This was an enthusiastic aunt who was responsible for managing the phone.
Liu Jimin didn't know the specific address of Zhu Lin's house, so he mentioned Professor Zhu, and the enthusiastic aunt immediately knew whose house it was.
"Should I call the eldest daughter of the Zhu family to come over and answer the phone?" the aunt said with a smile.
"You don't have to go through so much trouble, just give me a message."
"Sure, tell me...Oh, Professor Zhu, are you back from shopping? Just in time, your home phone number is for your daughter."
When Zhu Lin's father heard Liu Jimin's voice, he suddenly felt a bad feeling in his heart.
"Who are you? Are you familiar with our Linlin?"
Liu Jimin coughed and said seriously: "You are Comrade Zhu Lin's father, right? I am Comrade Zhu Lin's classmate, and I am currently rewriting the script at Yan Film Studio. The director feels that Comrade Zhu Lin is very suitable for a female role in it, so I would like to ask Comrade Zhu Lin for his opinion."
"Screenwriter? Aren't you liars?" Zhu's father muttered, obviously still a little unconvinced.
"Uncle Zhu, you ask Comrade Zhu Lin to answer the phone. You can tell whether it is true or false."
Father Zhu already believed it, but in order to ensure that there was no problem, he went home and called Zhu Lin over.
When Zhu Lin heard Liu Jimin's voice, he immediately covered the phone and whispered: "Comrade Jimin, why did you call me at home?"
"Cough!" Liu Jimin couldn't help coughing. He said this as if there was something shameful between the two of them.
Father Zhu just told someone to look for him, but he didn't say anything specific. But seeing Zhu Lin's tone, I knew that something was right.
hiss! But it's not normal for my daughter to look guilty while holding the phone!
Liu Jimin told Zhu Lin what happened, and she exclaimed: "Really?"
"Really! You have been preparing at home these two days, and then come to Yan Film Studio for an audition on August 19th."
